# Luminary Technicals
> Full extended knowledge corpus available at: https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/llms-full.txt

Luminary Technicals is a multidisciplinary organization connecting digital infrastructure, technology development, research, cybersecurity, education, and public-interest initiatives across five core organs and a directly associated entity. Founded and led by AR. Abhinav Ranjan (Founder & Digital Architect).

## Canonical Organizational Structure V2

**Luminary Technicals** is the central parent organization with exactly **5 Core Organs**:

- **Luminary Servers (POWER):** Cloud infrastructure, bare-metal servers, DNS, CDN, SSL, and high-availability hosting. (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/servers.html`)
- **Luminary Developers (CREATE):** Software engineering, AI systems, progressive web apps, and the Luminary Afterverse spatial computing lab. (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/developers.html`)
- **Luminary Cares (EMPOWER):** Technology education, digital literacy, mentorship, and community empowerment via Luminary Books. (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/cares.html`)
- **Luminary Kits (CONNECT):** Reusable developer toolkits, APIs, SDKs, and partner web collaborations including Luminary Webs. (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/kits.html`)
- **Luminary Federals (ENGAGE):** Civic technology, public affairs, governance research, and the official Luminary News platform. (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/federals.html`)

**Direct Associated Entity** (top-level, separate from the 5 organs):
- **Luminary Trust:** Public-interest, philanthropic ecosystem directly associated with Luminary Technicals. Oversees the **Radhika Research Foundation**. (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/trust.html`)

## Key Projects & Initiatives
- **AgroScan** (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/agroscan.html`): AI-driven precision agricultural diagnostics.
- **Luminary Afterverse** (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/afterverse.html`): Spatial computing and 3D interactive laboratory.
- **Luminary News** (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/news.html`): Official editorial and ecosystem news platform.
- **Luminary Webs / Luminary Wishes** (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/projects.html`): Curated web platforms and applications.
- **Luminary Books** (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/resources.html#books`): Technical guides, manuals, and open-access literature under Luminary Cares.
